verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents scheduled or recurring jobs or workflows in v0. The v0 API and SDK only offer programmatic access that a user could trigger from an external scheduler, which is a developer building block or workaround and earns no credit. The CI checks and 'Fix CI' actions are one-off, event-driven actions, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
